title: ECL handoff-request profile v1
description: Outbound PROPOSE-upward artifact emitted by a worker-never-router Eidolon (e.g. Gilgamesh, the generalist fallthrough) when a subtask crosses its bounded authority/scope and a named specialist should take it instead. This is a request the orchestrator routes, NOT a dispatch (edge_origin: emitted-request, R-050) — the emitter has no downstream handoffs of its own (roster handoffs.downstream: []). Wrapped by an ECL envelope; validates the YAML frontmatter only. Fields mirror mission-contract.v1.json's delegation-contract shape plus the two fields that make the request typed and boundary-evidenced.

eidolon.description: Only a worker-never-router Eidolon emits a handoff-request; v1 has exactly one emitter.

objective.description: A single, bounded statement of the subtask the suggested specialist would own.

mode.description: Coarse scope-access mode the suggested specialist would need.

deliverables.description: Named artifacts or outcomes the proposed handoff is expected to produce.

evidence_required.description: Externalized verification the eventual owner MUST attach before the subtask is considered complete.

stop_conditions.description: Named conditions under which the proposed subtask halts.

suggested_specialist.description: The specialist the emitter believes best owns this subtask. The orchestrator decides whether to route it there — the emitter never dispatches (AC-F05).

evidence_of_boundary.description: Why this subtask crosses the emitter's bounded authority/capability-class scope (e.g. a refuse_verbs hit, an authority-table denial, or a specialist-shaped signal outside the emitter's own methodology). Cite path:line or trace evidence where available.
